reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web Pomodoro timer focused on configurable focus and break cycles, with a sidebar and draggable panel plus optional completion notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可配置专注与休息周期、侧栏入口和可拖动浮动面板的番茄钟计时器。
summaries.en: A Pomodoro timer for DeepSeek Harness Web with configurable focus and break cycles, a sidebar entry, and a draggable floating panel.

capabilities: Runs configurable focus and break countdown cycles
Provides start, pause, reset, skip, and automatic phase-transition controls
Adds a sidebar entry and draggable floating panel to the web UI
Displays in-app completion reminders and optionally plays sound or sends browser notifications
Restores timer state after page reloads or browser restarts
